title: Escort, Then Push
setup: White's d-pawn is one square from the seventh, with the black rook waiting behind it on the d-file.
hint: The pawn has no defender at all. Which of your two pieces can cover the square it wants to stand on?
explanation:
## The Idea

Push at once and {{d7}} simply hangs to {{Rxd7}}. {{Kc6}} covers d7 first, and only then does the pawn move: {{Rc2+}} {{Kd7}}, and the king shepherds it home. Bring the escort first; the pawn moves last.
